players.product: Turnkey HPC data-center campuses leased to hyperscalers (Barber Lake, Black Pearl, Stingray - Texas) - ex-Bitcoin-mining, now 'Cipher Digital'

quarterly_data.signal: Cipher's 10-Q states that, as part of transactions to acquire wholly owned sites, it has deposits with Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and American Electric Power (AEP) to construct infrastructure providing the ability to energize each data center. The deposits are eligible to be returned if the data centers energize an agreed capacity within an agreed timeframe, and as of June 30, 2026 Cipher believes they will be returned.
